scope: one arm unless quantity_dual_station is specified

items.shared_geometry_scope: Microduck visual reference only; exact body gearbox SKU and precision mounting interface unverified
compatibility_checks: Label must read XL330-M288-T; reject M077 or other voltage/protocol variants.
Read model number 1200 and firmware before torque enable.
Confirm unique IDs on each isolated arm bus.
Confirm 3-pin TTL connector and cable keying.
Do not treat 0.52 N*m stall torque as continuous allowable torque.
Use only the 3-pin TTL port for XL330-M288-T.
U2D2 TTL port pin labels are 1 GND, 2 N/C, 3 DATA.
Verify the delivered USB connector revision and provide the matching host cable.
Confirm stable device identity and 1 Mbps communication before integration.
Continuity-test every cable by pin number, not wire color.
Preserve pin 1 GND, pin 2 VDD, pin 3 DATA end-to-end.
Cable current and flex life must be checked for the actual topology.
Provide strain relief and connector service loops.

requirements: Regulated 5.0 V output; adjustment cannot exceed the XL330 6.0 V maximum.
Candidate capacity 10 A per arm, subject to measured transient and continuous load.
Documented over-voltage, over-current, short-circuit, and thermal protection.
Mains-powered products must have appropriate third-party listing for the deployment region.
No electrical connection to the original Microduck battery positive.
Manual latching mushroom actuator with deliberate manual reset.
Two independent normally closed power poles or a suitable DC contactor arrangement, one arm per pole.
DC interrupt rating verified at the selected 5 V fault current and load characteristics.
Reset must not automatically resume motion or re-enable servo torque.
Fuse or resettable breaker protects the arm feeder.
Rating and trip curve coordinate with the selected conductor, connector, PSU, and measured startup current.
One protected VDD branch per actuator.
Protection must isolate a branch fault without relying on a thin daisy-chain conductor as the fuse.
Route TTL DATA as one multidrop bus.
Distribute VDD through individually protected branches.
Common GND between arm PSU, U2D2 TTL reference, and all six actuators.
No route from arm VDD to USB VBUS or the original robot power bus.
Clearly label pin numbers on PCB and harness.
Axis distances 65 mm, 55 mm, and 30 mm are design inputs.
Servo mounting holes remain blocked until official CAD and physical fit review.
Load-bearing joints require dual-side support or bearings in the released design.
Retain 220 mm nominal and 180-240 mm adjustment only as the historical candidate.
Current simulation layouts use 150 mm base-center spacing for arms-handover-v1 and 242 mm for arms-co-carry-v1.
A shared physical station must adjust across at least 150-242 mm, or separate/redesigned platforms and updated simulation validation are required.
Do not claim actual arm, clamp, tray, cable, or workspace fit from the simulation base-center dimensions.
No servo mounting holes or actuator mating tolerances are defined by this station concept.
Soft liner and rounded edges.
Tray covers the tested low-height drop zone.
Tray does not substitute for guarding, supervision, or an e-stop.

forbidden_connections: arm VDD to original Microduck battery
arm VDD to original Microduck actuator bus
U2D2 TTL port used as a servo power source
two arms sharing one unprotected 5 V feeder
unverified hobby-servo three-pin cable substituted by appearance
